claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
One Battle After Another won six Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson, Sara Murphy, and Adam Somner are the producers for One Battle After Another's Best Picture Oscar.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson's Best Director win was his first win.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn was not in attendance.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
One Battle After Another won Best Editing at the 98th Academy Awards.
Cassandra Kulukundis won Best Casting for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Best Casting is the first-ever award in this category.
One Battle After Another was inspired by Thomas Pynchon's Vineland.
One Battle After Another features Leonardo DiCaprio.
One Battle After Another defeated Sinners.
Deadline highlighted that One Battle After Another swept several major awards at the ceremony.
The Guardian highlighted that One Battle After Another swept several major awards at the ceremony.
